handoff: review#2: review#1 F1-F8 fixed; blocking R2-F1 duplicate refusal prints <step>#undefined for step-only receipts, R2-F2 AC4 'finishes' clause not proven on its own, R2-F3 AC2 tested with approve not answer; minors R2-F4..F8

findings.title: Duplicate refusal of a step-only receipt says 'review#undefined'
findings.detail:
refuseDuplicate builds `${receipt.step}#${receipt.attempt}`, and a step-only receipt has no attempt. The second `norn story approve gh-N` from a local non-holder (tested only by its code in AC1 at mailbox-across-machines.test.ts:186) therefore prints 'approve already recorded for ready#undefined …'.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use the step-only label (`step` when attempt is absent), as story.ts:323 does, through one shared helper (the same label is also in inbox/items.ts:792). Assert the refusal text in the AC1 approve test.

findings.title: Nothing proves the 'or gh-9 finishes' clause of AC4 on its own
findings.detail:
The story finishes through `story approve`, an accepted approval that clears the item by itself (openRejections). The test would still pass if the storyFinished branch in inbox/items.ts rejectedItems were removed. AC4: 'when a later answer or approval for gh-9 is accepted, or gh-9 finishes, then the item is gone'.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Finish the story without an accepted answer or approval after the rejection (e.g. drop it, or merge its PR through FakeRemote), then assert the item is gone.

findings.title: AC2 is tested with an approval, not an answer
findings.detail:
AC2: 'Given gh-9 under `remote`, when B answers, then the receipt is stamped with the step and attempt from the fetched ref.' Only `story approve` is exercised under remote. The path is shared, but the case the criterion names is untested.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a remote-policy `story answer` from B on an asking story: assert step and attempt from the ref, and that the holder applies it.

findings.title: A rejection is cleared by comparing two machines' clocks
findings.detail:
openRejections clears a rejection when an accepted receipt's `at` is later than `rejected_at`. `at` comes from the sender's machine and `rejected_at` from the holder's, so clock skew can clear the item too early or keep it too long.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Order by the holder's own sequence: the receipt number, compared with the unit's last receipt number at the time of the rejection.

findings.title: A gate reject also clears the Check item
findings.detail:
openRejections counts answer, approve and reject. B21/D12 say 'a later answer or approval … is accepted'. Counting a gate decision of either kind is a fair reading, but it is untested and a person should confirm it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Confirm at the ready gate, or limit it to answer and approve.

findings.title: tidy ages out a rejection that is still open
findings.detail:
D12: 'It clears on its own when a later answer or approval … is accepted, or when the story finishes. There is no dismiss command.' Pruning by trace.retain (from review#1 F3) also removes an open item. It is not a dismiss command, but no spec line names it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Prune only entries already cleared or whose story finished, or have the person confirm the age-out and note it in D12.

findings.title: The Check item's 'is at X now' is the step at rejection time
findings.detail:
The title uses at_step, recorded when the receipt was rejected. Once the unit moves on, the item names a step it is no longer at.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Render from the unit's current step in facts (the story is held here), falling back to at_step.

findings.title: keepRejected (act) works out the record from facts that decide already has
findings.detail:
Act looks up the mailbox receipt and the unit's step in obs.facts (Feature Envy; arguably decision-making outside decide). If decide put it on the reject_receipt action, it would show in the trace and in replay (O5).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Carry the record on the action.

findings.title: Step-only needs two flags per verb
findings.detail:
Each mailbox verb passes `stepOnly: true` to resolveTarget and also a stepOnly builder to runHumanVerb (story-approve.ts:47,65; run-rerun.ts:33,59).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Let the builder imply the flag.

findings.title: A step-only `story reject` from a non-holder has no test
findings.detail:
It shares approve's decideGate path.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: One assertion in the AC1 approve test.
